newsitem.title: USA: Biomet extends share repurchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Biomet extends share repurchase plan.

text.p: Biomet Inc said Wednesday its board of directors extended a previously announced share buyback program, authorizing the purchase of up to an additional $60 million of common shares.
Biomet said about 4,000,000 shares have been purchased under the previously announced repurchase plan.
The shares will be purchased in open market or privately negotiated transactions.
The purchases may be made from time to time between January 29, 1997, and January 28, 1998.
Shares acquired will be designated as treasury shares and will be available for general corporate purposes including use in the 401(k) and stock option plans.
Biomet designs, makes and markets products used by orthopedic medical specialists.
